fingerprint_rule: Raw file bytes; paths sorted by JS default sort; SHA256 of concatenated lowercase-sha256 + two spaces + slash-separated path + LF. Documentation/progress and target excluded. Sensitive to line endings; not a Git revision or CI attestation.
covered_paths: Crates, frontend, desktop, scripts and workflow; selected root build/tool configuration; Node CLI runner and scenario fixtures. Excludes Markdown, progress, target and installed dependencies.
source_scope: Measured Rust runner uses the local trace patch; fixture helper added after measurement and verified byte-identical. Engine/audio processing unchanged from baseline.

one-second voice windows plus full lifecycle, not prolonged stress
